fixes.explanation: One more battle? Not this time, friend. Moses has just reminded Joshua what the LORD did to "…these two kings." (Deuteronomy 3:21). But what he asks for is something else: "Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan…" (Deuteronomy 3:25). No sword in sight, just a request to see the land.

problems.problem: Saying Moses has seen enough battles to last him a lifetime suggests he feels he has had enough. The passage does not say that.
